gas.dispatch_class: selector % BUCKETS; CODECOPY one uint16 bucket entry to mem[30:32]; MLOAD; JUMP; per-bucket XOR chain (sel checksum)

noopt.dispatch_class: linear source-order EQ+ISZERO chain; per-leg calldata/value guards inline; PUSH2 handler jump

codesize.dispatch_class: minimal-perfect-hash direct table: CODECOPY 5-byte header; index=((sel*K)>>24)%count; CODECOPY 7-byte entry; verify selector; tag guard; JUMP handler
